note: Guardian Druid boss-specific lines were written by applying general principles to each mechanic (Ironfur for physical tank busters; Barkskin and Survival Instincts for magic and armor-ignoring busters; Remove Corruption for poisons and curses), because Wowhead's Mythic+ guide only says "nothing special" for each dungeon. Damage types of each mechanic were checked against in-game tooltips.

general.sub: Kit summary · pick a hero talent above

i: Line up Lunar Beam (1 min) with big pulls and boss burst windows. With Boundless Moonlight you leech 12% of damage dealt inside the beam
During Lunar Beam your Mastery and self-healing go up, so taking big tank busters in this window is stable
Wowhead recommends Elune's Chosen for raid, Mythic+ and Delves. Slightly better AoE and defense
When auto attacks proc Ravage, your next Maul becomes a frontal AoE attack. Show the icon so you don't miss the proc
Single-target damage is similar to Elune's Chosen but with less defensive support. Prioritize Ironfur
AoE is slightly lower than Elune's Chosen (Wowhead)
Ironfur · 40 Rage · Armor up for 7 sec, stacks. Several casts before physical tank busters
Frenzied Regeneration · 10 Rage · heals 24% health over 3 sec
Barkskin · 45 sec · 20% reduction to all damage taken for 8 sec, usable while stunned
Survival Instincts · 3 min (reduced by Survival of the Fittest), 1 charge · 50% reduction to all damage taken for 6 sec
Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc · 3 min · 30% max health for 30 sec
Lunar Beam · 1 min · more self-healing and Mastery for 8 sec
Stampeding Roar · 2 min · 60% party movement speed for 8 sec
Heart of the Wild · 2 min · heals 5 party members in humanoid form
During a Dream of Cenarius proc, Regrowth is instant and free, usable in Bear Form
Stack Ironfur for physical tank busters, Barkskin for magic ones. Survival Instincts for armor-ignoring attacks
Skull Bash is a 15 sec charge interrupt. Multiple casters: Incapacitating Roar
Hold scattered trash with Ursol's Vortex and push it away with Typhoon
Remove Corruption: dispels poisons and curses. Leave diseases and magic to a party member who can dispel them
Devour week: the shield is removed by healing received or a dispel. Clear party members' shields with Remove Corruption and your own with Frenzied Regeneration
Ascendant week: grouped orbs with Incapacitating Roar, single ones with Skull Bash
Pulsar week: Stampeding Roar to reach the orbs
Xal'atath's Guile at +12 and above: 15 sec lost per death

druid-of-the-claw.title: Druid of the Claw notes
items: On big trash pulls, spend {Ravage} procs right away instead of {Maul}
Tank busters to take with {Ironfur} stacks checked: {busters}

Rav'i: [탱버] The 3-hit Hydrastrike is physical damage: stack Ironfur right before it, and heal with Frenzied Regeneration if you are low after
[탱버] If Hydrastrike comes while you are low, pop Barkskin or Survival Instincts first
[해제] Guardian Druid cannot dispel the Regurgitate disease, so leave it to a party member who can
[위치] If the empty pile is far, use Stampeding Roar to speed up the party and drag the boss
The Writhing Coil: [탱버] Tail Scythe is a single 3 sec cast Physical hit (678877), so have at least 2 Ironfur stacks up before the cast. It does not hurt the tank much (Topicx), so save Survival Instincts for Death Rattle and the Uncoil phase.
[차단] Put Skull Bash into the three-cast Toxic Atrophy rotation. Skull Bash is 15 sec, so it can cover only one cast per cycle.

[위치] During Uncoil, gather the Uncoiled Writhes and pin them in one spot with Ursol's Vortex. Neither Mythic+ build takes a stun, so slow the Writhes' melee and Toxic Atrophy with Incapacitating Roar (10 yards, 3 sec) and Typhoon (knockback, 50% slow for 6 sec).
[해제] Spiteful Venom stacks are a poison that Remove Corruption (8 sec cooldown) can clear, so cleanse the fixated player with the highest stacks first.
Zul'jan: [탱버] Take Chop Down (1.5 sec cast, two hits of 484912 Physical) with 2-3 Ironfur stacks and top up with Frenzied Regeneration if you are low. If Chop Down comes while you are still low from soaking a beam, press Survival Instincts.

[탱버] When you deliberately touch a slowed Axegrinder axe to clear leftover Ritual Venom, the axe deals Physical damage that ignores armor and Ironfur does not reduce it, so press Barkskin before you touch it.

[위치] Ritual Venom is not a dispellable poison, so do not spend Remove Corruption on it. If you are late to your assigned beam spot, run there with the party under Stampeding Roar (1 min with talents).

Lightblossom Trinity: [탱버] Bedrock Slam is 484912 Physical plus 193965 Nature, so it is mostly physical. Start stacking Ironfur 2-3 times just before the Lightblossom Beam soak ends.

[위치] While you stand in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam, the Holy and Nature damage is not reduced by Ironfur, so press Barkskin. If your health is low, top up with Frenzied Regeneration before Bedrock Slam lands.
[차단] Interrupt Kezkitt's Light Bolt with Skull Bash (15 sec).
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Guardian Druid cannot remove allies' Bloodthorn Roots, so hit the roots with the boss AoE to break them fast.
[탱버] Use Survival Instincts for Thorncaller Roar during Frenzy.
[참고] If party AoE damage is high, spend Dream of Cenarius procs on Regrowth for weak party members.
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] In Moonkin Form, Warden's Wrath is repeated Nature (magic) damage on the tank that Ironfur does not reduce. Interrupt it with Skull Bash, and press Barkskin if you miss and take several in a row.

[탱버] In Bear Form, Mangling Claws doubles melee hits, so keep Ironfur up without gaps. The Grievous Thrash bleed only ends at full health, so top off with Frenzied Regeneration to clear it before the next Grievous Thrash.
[탱버] Save Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc and Survival Instincts for the 40% Spirits of the Vale phase and split them across it.
Ziekket: [탱버] Thornspike's initial hit is 193965 Holy, which Ironfur does not reduce, so take it with Barkskin. Handle the following 10 sec Physical bleed (58189 per sec) with Ironfur stacks and Frenzied Regeneration.

[차단] Lightspore Shot usually targets the tank (Topicx). Interrupt casts from Lashers before they revive with Skull Bash, and use Incapacitating Roar when several cast at once. Revived Lashers are immune to interrupts and crowd control.
[위치] Grab aggro from the middle of the Lashers, then drop Ursol's Vortex on the pack to keep it from scattering.

The Hoardmonger: [해제] The tank soaks 3-4 mushrooms every time and stacks Toxic Spores poison, so use Remove Corruption (8 sec cooldown) on yourself or the player with the highest stacks.

[참고] Ravenous Bellow and Hearty Bellow are not aimed at the tank. They are armor-ignoring Physical damage on everyone, so Ironfur does not reduce them. Press Barkskin only when mushroom poison has left you low.
[위치] Reach far mushrooms within 12 sec with Stampeding Roar (1 min with talents).
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Interrupt Winter's Shroud (4 sec cast) from the Fractured Shivercore next to the boss, the one the tank and melee handle, with Skull Bash (15 sec). Incapacitating Roar (10 yards) does not reach the ranged side add, so leave that one to ranged interrupts.
[탱버] If you are hit by Frozen Tempest (Frost damage) outside a Snowdrift, press Barkskin and Survival Instincts. Ironfur does not reduce magic damage.
[위치] If the Rimeshatter soaker is late, step on it yourself and recover with Frenzied Regeneration.
Nalorakk: [탱버] The Overwhelming Onslaught triple hit (315193 Physical every sec for 3 sec) ignores armor, so Ironfur does not reduce it. Take it with Survival Instincts, and use Barkskin plus Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc on casts where Survival Instincts is down.
[탱버] Forceful Slam (5 sec cast, 775859 Physical), which you soak within 6 yards right after the knockback, is reduced by armor, so stack Ironfur 2-3 times for it.
[참고] When targeted by Echoing Maul, the Echo lands with 193965 Nature damage within 8 yards, so press Barkskin. If Spectral Slash or Echoing Fury damage piles up, top up with Frenzied Regeneration.

Kystia Manaheart: [탱버] Chaos Barrage (3 sec cast, 290947 Chaos) repeats all fight and Ironfur does not reduce it. Press Barkskin (12 sec) to cover two or more casts, and on casts where Barkskin is not back, use Survival Instincts or Lunar Beam so you never eat several in a row unmitigated.
[차단] Interrupt one Mirror Image with Skull Bash, and stop Felstorm from the gathered images with Incapacitating Roar.
[차단] Pin scattered images in one spot with Ursol's Vortex.
[해제] Corroding Spittle is magic, which a Guardian Druid cannot dispel, so leave it to the healer.
Zaen Bladesorrow: [탱버] The Warehouse Workers dragged in at the start hit hard in melee, so press Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc and Survival Instincts. Keen Taskmaster's Back to Work! (+200% Worker attack speed) is an Enrage, so remove it with Soothe.
[탱버] For Envenom (3 sec cast, 436421 Physical), stack Ironfur 2-3 times and add Barkskin.
[해제] The following Heartstop Poison (-30% max health) is a poison, so clear it from yourself at once with Remove Corruption (8 sec cooldown).
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] Legion Strike (3 sec cast, 533403 Physical) cuts healing received by 80% for 8 sec, which also weakens Frenzied Regeneration, so take it with 3 Ironfur stacks plus Barkskin.

[탱버] Demonic Rage raises the boss's attack speed by 75% for 15 sec, so press Survival Instincts and Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc and keep Ironfur up. For the Infernal Crush that follows Axe Toss, use the remaining Barkskin or Lunar Beam.
[위치] Use Stampeding Roar (1 min with talents) to move the boss quickly to the Axe Toss axe.
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Interrupt Chaos Bolt with Skull Bash.
[차단] Hold Wild Imp packs with Ursol's Vortex and stop Felfire Burst with Incapacitating Roar.
[탱버] Furious Vilefiend's Shadow Bite carries shadow damage, so take it with Barkskin.

Taz'Rah: [탱버] Void Blast (2 sec cast, 271551 Shadow, knockback) is not reduced by Ironfur, so press a defensive every time. Use Barkskin (about 34 sec cooldown with talents, 30% reduction for 12 sec) as the default, and Survival Instincts or Lunar Beam on casts where Barkskin is not back.
[참고] If Dark Bloom deals heavy party damage, use Heart of the Wild out of form to heal the party.
Atroxus: [탱버] Hulking Claw (2 sec cast, 242456 Nature plus a 10 sec Nature DoT) is not reduced by Ironfur. Alternate Barkskin and Survival Instincts, and cover casts where both are down with Lunar Beam and Frenzied Regeneration (2 charges from Innate Resolve).
[회피] Toxic Creeper fixates the tank and follows you, so open distance with Stampeding Roar (1 min with talents) or Typhoon (knockback, 50% slow for 6 sec) and do not take Sickening Bite stacks.
[해제] Poison Splash's poison DoT and the Mind-Numbing Poison from Poison Pool are poisons, so clear them with Remove Corruption (8 sec cooldown).
Charonus: [탱버] Dark Waves is a shadow frontal: take it with Barkskin plus Survival Instincts.
[참고] Guardian Druid cannot remove Condensed Mass stacks, so leave movement-impairment dispels to party members.
[참고] When Cosmic Crash DoTs pull party health down, use Dream of Cenarius procs to Regrowth weak party members.

The Golden Serpent: [탱버] Tail Thrash is physical damage, so keep Ironfur up when it is cast.
[차단] Hold Animated Gold packs heading to the boss with Ursol's Vortex and push them away with Typhoon.
[위치] Use Stampeding Roar to reposition fast when dragging the boss away from gold piles.
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Skull Bash on the mummies' Wretched Discharge first; if there are several, delay them with Incapacitating Roar.
[위치] When awakened mummies scatter, hold them next to the boss with Ursol's Vortex.
[위치] During the Entomb coffin search, use Stampeding Roar to reach the far coffin quickly.
The Council of Tribes: [탱버] Aka'ali's Debilitating Backhand (2 sec cast, 727368 Physical, knockback) applies Shattered Defenses, which increases Physical damage taken by 200%, so stack Ironfur to 2-3 and press Survival Instincts (about 2 min 17 sec cooldown with talents, 60% reduction for 6 sec) before the cast. Never let Ironfur drop while the debuff is up.
[탱버] On casts where Survival Instincts is not back, take Backhand with Barkskin and Ironfur, then use Stampeding Roar (1 min with talents) for speed and kite Aka'ali until Shattered Defenses ends.

[탱버] Zanazal's Arc Lightning (1 sec cast, 135775 Nature) hits the tank right after the pull and is not reduced by Ironfur, so press Barkskin (about 34 sec cooldown with talents, 30% reduction for 12 sec).
[차단] Save Skull Bash for Poison Nova (4 sec cast, 12 sec Nature DoT), and if it lands, it is a Poison, so clear it with Remove Corruption.
Dazar, The First King: [탱버] Save your major defensives in phase 1 and hold with Ironfur and Frenzied Regeneration. Spend them after 80% when T'zala's Savage Maul and Blade Combo overlap.

[탱버] Savage Maul's bleed (193965 Physical plus a bleed, +10% Physical damage taken for 10 sec) is not reduced by Ironfur, so on every overlap keep Ironfur stacked, press Barkskin, and alternate Survival Instincts and Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc on top. If both are down, ask for an external defensive.
[차단] Interrupt Reban's Deathly Roar (4 sec cast, party Shadow damage and a 4 sec fear) with Skull Bash.

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] Interrupt Frigid Shard (2.5 sec cast) yourself with Skull Bash (15 sec) right after Hailburst ice lands, and drag the boss out of the ice.
[탱버] An uninterrupted Frigid Shard is 775859 Physical, so keep Ironfur up and use Frenzied Regeneration right after it hits.
[위치] When Infused Whelps appear, hold them on top of the boss with Ursol's Vortex and grab threat with Thrash.

[해제] Cold Claws is Magic, which Guardian cannot remove, so kill the Whelps quickly. If you reach 20 stacks and get Frozen Solid (5 sec stun), Barkskin can be used while stunned, so press it right away.
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] Stack Ironfur for every Searing Blows (3 sec channel, 4 Physical strikes), and press Barkskin (about 34 sec cooldown with talents, 30% reduction for 12 sec) with it because Ironfur does not reduce the Searing Wounds Fire DoT that each strike stacks. On high keys, add Survival Instincts.
[차단] Use Skull Bash on Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley.
[참고] On Searing Blows where Barkskin is not back, cover the Fire DoT with Lunar Beam (1 min, self-healing for 8 sec) and Frenzied Regeneration.
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [탱버] Take Stormslam (387930 Physical and 193965 Nature) with Ironfur only and save Barkskin and Survival Instincts.

[탱버] If you are targeted by Inferno Spit, step out of the party and press Barkskin as the 6 sec DoT ends and explodes for 8 yards. Keep Survival Instincts and Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc for phase 2 so you can stack them there.

[해제] Stormslam's Nature damage taken increase is Magic, which Guardian cannot remove, so ask the healer to dispel it before the next Stormslam. If dispel is late and Stormslam lands on stacks, use Survival Instincts.

Adderis & Aspix: [탱버] Adderis's Overload (100% attack speed for 8 sec, 25% of each melee hit added as Nature damage) is mostly Physical, so never let Ironfur drop, and top up with Frenzied Regeneration when you get low.

[탱버] Thunder and Lightning (581895 Nature split within 8 yards and 387930 Nature within 20 yards) is not reduced by Ironfur, so press Barkskin (about 34 sec cooldown with talents, 30% reduction for 12 sec) as you stack for the split.
[참고] If party damage is heavy during the Thunder and Lightning split, use Heart of the Wild out of form to heal the party.
Merektha: [탱버] Stack Ironfur for every Lightning Bite (3 sec cast, 533403 Physical and a 7 sec Nature DoT) and layer Barkskin for the Nature DoT. Use Survival Instincts on casts where Barkskin is down and on high keys.
[위치] Watch the egg positions on the floor before Hatch, and grab Storm Serpent threat first with Moonfire or Growl when it wakes.
[제어] When the two A Knot of Snakes targets stack, incapacitate the knot with Incapacitating Roar to free them.
[차단] Interrupt Toxic Viper's Poison Spit with Skull Bash, and the DoT is a Poison, so clear it with Remove Corruption.
Galvazzt: [위치] Move the boss to the next corner every time an Induction Field drops. If the beam soakers need to swap spots, raise party movement speed with Stampeding Roar (1 min with talents).
[참고] The tank does not soak beams. Cast the Dream of Cenarius Regrowth on a soaker who is losing health to Galvanized.
[참고] If a beam soaker dies, bring them back right away with Rebirth.
Avatar of Sethraliss: [탱버] Tainted Strike is physical and shadow damage: keep Ironfur up and use Barkskin as stacks build.
[차단] Interrupt Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock with Skull Bash.
[위치] If a pack of Faithless Tormentors heads to the healer, hold them with Ursol's Vortex or Incapacitating Roar.

40미터 내의 적에게 강화된 별똥별을 떨어뜨려 8초에 걸쳐 [54 * (주문력의 27%)]의 천공 피해를 입힙니다.

[차단] Interrupt Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Skull Bash.
8: [탱버] Press Barkskin for Spouting Floret. Save Survival Instincts and Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc for the 40% phase of the next boss, Lightwarden Ruia.

[해제] Remove Corruption (8 sec cooldown) clears Toxic Spew poison from only one player at a time, so cleanse the lowest-health player first.
11: [탱버] Split your defensives: Barkskin for Spouting Floret, Ironfur stacks plus Survival Instincts for Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash. Clear the Gash bleed by topping yourself off with Frenzied Regeneration.
[차단] Keep the three Lightfeather Petalwings close. When they cast Disorienting Screech together, stop them all with Incapacitating Roar, then Skull Bash the remaining cast.

[차단] Split the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Skull Bash and Incapacitating Roar.

When the stacks get high, knock them back with Typhoon (30 sec, 50% slow for 6 sec) so the 2 sec stacks fall off.
[탱버] If a Piercing Hiss interrupt is missed and it lands, press Barkskin (about 34 sec cooldown with talents, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec). Save Survival Instincts for Dismember in pull 2.
2: [탱버] For Ritual Chieftain's Dismember (3 sec cast, 581895 Physical), stack Ironfur 2-3 times and press Survival Instincts (about 2 min 17 sec cooldown with talents, 60% reduction for 6 sec).

[차단] Interrupt Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Skull Bash.

[해제] Cleanse the Envenom poison from the two High Evolutionists with Remove Corruption, one player at a time.

14: [차단] Interrupt Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom with Skull Bash.

15: [차단] Split the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss between Skull Bash and Incapacitating Roar. Even with four Blades of the Altar in the pack, spend Roar on the Serpent casts first.
16: [탱버] Two Ritual Chieftains bring back-to-back Dismembers, so press Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc as soon as you pull if it is back. Use Survival Instincts on the first Dismember and 3 Ironfur stacks plus Barkskin on the second.

1: [탱버] Shield Bash from Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard (3 sec cast, +20% Physical damage taken for 20 sec) overlaps, so press Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc (3 min, +30% max health) with Bloodlust and never let Ironfur drop. Press Survival Instincts (about 2 min 17 sec cooldown with talents, 60% reduction for 6 sec) when two Physical damage-taken debuffs are up at once.
[해제] If Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison stacks (5% max health each) pile up on you, clear them yourself with Remove Corruption (8 sec cooldown).

[위치] Pin the Tiny Felwyrms from Summon Wyrms in one spot with Ursol's Vortex (1 min) and kill them together with Thrash.
8: [해제] If a Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (60% less damage taken, crowd control immunity) is not interrupted, remove it with Soothe (10 sec cooldown) since it is an Enrage.

[탱버] Shivan Punisher gains 30% Physical damage per stack of Punishing Might each time its melee misses or is dodged, so keep thick Ironfur stacks. Press Barkskin when Shadow Bite (Shadow) from the two Trained Felhunters overlaps.
[차단] Interrupt Fel Invoker's Health Funnel channel with Skull Bash.
9: [해제] Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom (581895 Shadow after 10 sec) is a Curse, so clear it at once with Remove Corruption.
[해제] Remove an uninterrupted Wrathguard Flayer Fel Rage with Soothe.

11: [탱버] Shadow Bite (Shadow) from two Trained Felhunters and Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (Fire) are magic damage that Ironfur does not reduce. Alternate Barkskin and Survival Instincts on each Blade Dance, and fill the gaps with Lunar Beam (1 min, self-healing for 8 sec).
13: [해제] Remove an uninterrupted Fel Rage from the two Wrathguard Flayers with Soothe.
[차단] When the six Unleashed Imps, gathered by dragging other packs onto them, cast Felfire Burst, stop them all with Incapacitating Roar.
[탱버] Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to everyone) is not reduced by Ironfur, so press Barkskin when you are low.
14: [해제] Remove an uninterrupted Fel Rage from the two Wrathguard Flayers with Soothe.
[탱버] Press Barkskin when Shadow Bite from the two Trained Felhunters piles up.
[차단] Interrupt Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Skull Bash and stop the Unleashed Imps' Felfire Burst with Incapacitating Roar.
15: [해제] While you drag Corrupted Warlock back and kill it first, clear Curse of Doom at once with Remove Corruption.
[탱버] Shadow Bite (Shadow) from three Trained Felhunters is not reduced by Ironfur, so press Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc if it is back and split Barkskin and Survival Instincts across the pull.
16: [차단] Split the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel between Skull Bash and Incapacitating Roar.
[탱버] Use Barkskin for Shadow Bite from the two Trained Felhunters, and Survival Instincts when Defiled Slam overlaps.

2: [차단] Interrupt Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) with Skull Bash (15 sec).
[해제] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath with Soothe and the Insatiable Hunger curse with Remove Corruption.
3: [차단] Interrupt Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Skull Bash.
[해제] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath with Soothe and the Insatiable Hunger curse with Remove Corruption.
4: [해제] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath with Soothe.
[탱버] If Razor Dive bleeds from the three Keen-Eyed Strikers (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec, stacking) pile up on you, press Barkskin and top up with Frenzied Regeneration.
5: [해제] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath with Soothe while you drag the pack to the boss spot.

10: [탱버] Use Barkskin for Frostbite from three Frostfangs, and Survival Instincts when Bloodrush overlaps.

[차단] Interrupt Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning (4 sec cast) with Skull Bash.
14: [해제] Bestial Wrath from the three Bonded Beasttamers is an Enrage that Soothe removes. Soothe has a 10 sec cooldown, so clear the pet that is fixating someone first.
[차단] Interrupt Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Skull Bash.
15: [탱버] The four Grizzled Warbringers do not cast Primal Echo at the same time, so rotate one defensive per Echo: Survival Instincts, then Barkskin, then Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc, then Lunar Beam (1 min).

[해제] Remove Bonded Beasttamer's Bestial Wrath with Soothe.

2: [탱버] Press Barkskin during Raj'kess the Spellstorm's Thundering Storm and top up with Frenzied Regeneration if you are low.

[탱버] Keep Ironfur up for Savage Shredclaw's Shred Defense (145474 Physical, +20% damage taken for 10 sec). If you are targeted by Void Beam, step out of the party and press Barkskin.

[차단] Interrupt Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Skull Bash, and stop Dominated Brawler's Demoralizing Shout together with it using Incapacitating Roar if they overlap.
8: [탱버] Press Barkskin for Devouring Brutalizer's Dreadbellow (4.5 sec cast, 12 sec Shadow DoT), and use 3 Ironfur stacks plus Survival Instincts for the Brutalize that always follows (678877 Physical every 1.5 sec for 6 sec).
[차단] Interrupt Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Skull Bash first, and stop the two Voidminders' Mending Void channel with Incapacitating Roar when you have room.
[탱버] If Shred Defense from three Savage Shredclaws stacks up your damage taken, drop Lunar Beam (1 min, self-healing for 8 sec) to hold.

10: [탱버] Use Survival Instincts on Devouring Brutalizer's Brutalize if it is back; otherwise use Barkskin and 3 Ironfur stacks. When you chain-pull Watchful Harrower and get targeted by Void Beam, hold with any remaining Barkskin or Frenzied Regeneration.
[해제] Remove Feral Rage from the two Feral Saberons with Soothe.

2: [차단] Interrupt Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse DoT) with Skull Bash (15 sec). If it goes through, the DoT is a Curse, so remove it from party members with Remove Corruption (8 sec cooldown).
[탱버] Press Barkskin, which is back after pull 1, for Shadow Whirlwind, and remove Ancestral Fury with Soothe. Save Survival Instincts for the bleed pack in pull 4.

6: [차단] Guardian cannot dispel the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, party-wide disease DoT). Interrupt one with Skull Bash, and if both are within 10 yards, stop them together with Incapacitating Roar.

[해제] Remove the Putrid Seekers poison DoT from the eight Embalming Fluids with Remove Corruption.
9: [차단] The two Phantom Hex Priests cast Spectral Bolt and Hex nonstop, so pull them within 10 yards and stop both with Incapacitating Roar, then interrupt later casts with Skull Bash. Hex (5 sec polymorph) is a Curse, so free the party member with Remove Corruption.

[탱버] The two Royal Berserkers' Bloodthirsty Axe (12 sec Physical bleed) is not reduced by Ironfur, so hold through stacks with Barkskin and Frenzied Regeneration (2 charges from Innate Resolve). Save Survival Instincts for Soul Crush in pull 10.
10: [탱버] For Ghostly Brute's Soul Crush (2.5 sec cast, 727368 Physical, +30% Physical damage taken for 15 sec), stack Ironfur to 2-3 and press Survival Instincts. Keep Ironfur up for the following 15 sec, and if Survival Instincts is down, use Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc or Lunar Beam (1 min, self-healing for 8 sec) instead.

[회피] When you see Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby and a knock-up), step away from Ghostly Brute. If melee party members need to get out too, use Stampeding Roar (1 min with talents, +60% movement speed).
[차단] Interrupt Phantom Hex Priest's casts with Skull Bash and free Hex targets with Remove Corruption.
12: [탱버] Shadow of Zul's Shadow Barrage (58190 Shadow plus a 4 sec DoT) goes to whoever engages first, so open with Moonfire (40 yards, instant) and press Barkskin. It is Shadow damage that Ironfur does not reduce.
[탱버] If you are targeted by Dark Revelation (473120 Shadow within 20 yards after 5 sec) and step away from the party without Barkskin ready, press Survival Instincts.

Ironfur does not reduce the Nature part, so press Survival Instincts (about 2 min 17 sec cooldown with talents, 60% reduction for 6 sec) if it lands while Tectonic Strike stacks are high. This is a big first pull gathered up to the entrance, so press Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc (3 min, +30% max health) too.

2: [탱버] Stack Ironfur for Primal Juggernaut's Crushing Smash, and add Barkskin (about 34 sec cooldown with talents, 30% reduction for 12 sec) if Tectonic Strike stacks are high. If the stacks keep rising, push the Earthshaper away with Typhoon and back off.
[차단] Interrupt Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield channel with Skull Bash.
3: [탱버] Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage (242456 Physical every 0.5 sec for 3 sec) needs a defensive every time. Stack Ironfur to 2-3 for each cast and add one of Survival Instincts, Barkskin, then Lunar Beam (1 min, self-healing for 8 sec) in that order.
[차단] Interrupt Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Skull Bash, and push the Earthshapers away with Typhoon so that high Tectonic Strike stacks do not line up with Steel Barrage.
5: [탱버] Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast (4 sec cast, 358835 Fire) targets only the tank and is not reduced by Ironfur, so press Barkskin. Spend Skull Bash on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt first.

[제어] Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel, 96982 Fire and 242456 Physical every sec to its current target) cannot be interrupted and hits the tank, so stop it with Incapacitating Roar (10 yards, 3 sec incapacitate). If you cannot stop it, stack Ironfur and press Survival Instincts.
6: [탱버] Stack Ironfur to 2-3 for Flamegullet's Fire Maw (2.5 sec cast, 581895 Physical and 96982 Fire, 6 sec Fire DoT), and press Barkskin for Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast. If the two casts overlap, add Survival Instincts, and press Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc with it if it is back for this pull.
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Incapacitating Roar and interrupt Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Skull Bash.
7: [탱버] Press Barkskin for Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast. If Barkskin is not back, cover it with Lunar Beam and Frenzied Regeneration (2 charges from Innate Resolve).
[제어] Stop both Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage together with Incapacitating Roar and interrupt Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Skull Bash.
8: [탱버] Press Barkskin for Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast and stop the two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage with Incapacitating Roar. If a missed Flaming Barrage keeps hitting you, press Survival Instincts.
10: [차단] Tempest Channeler's Thunder Blast (4 sec cast, 387930 Nature) targets only the tank. This pull has no other interrupt target, so kick it with Skull Bash and take it with Barkskin if Skull Bash is on cooldown. Ironfur does not reduce it.

[광역 피해] If a party member is the Lightning Torrent target (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec), cast the Dream of Cenarius Regrowth on them. If you are the target, press Barkskin or Survival Instincts.
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Incapacitating Roar.
11: [탱버] Press Barkskin for Tempest Channeler's Thunder Blast and spend Skull Bash on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt. If Barkskin is not back from pull 10, spend Skull Bash on Thunder Blast instead.
12: [광역 피해] If High Channeler Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield expires unbroken, everyone within 60 yards is stunned for 4 sec. Barkskin can be used while stunned, so press it right after the stun, and press Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc when the Stormshield goes up if it is back.
[탱버] If you are the Lightning Torrent target, press Barkskin or Survival Instincts; if a party member is the target, cast the Dream of Cenarius Regrowth on them.

1: [탱버] For Sandfury Stonefist's Sunder Slam (3 sec cast, 387930 Physical, +50% Physical damage taken for 10 sec, stacking), stack Ironfur to 2-3, and press Survival Instincts (about 2 min 17 sec cooldown with talents, 60% reduction for 6 sec) if a second Sunder Slam comes within 10 sec. This is the dungeon's first big pull, so press Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc (3 min, +30% max health) too.

[차단] Bring the three Storm Adepts to you by kicking the first cast with Skull Bash (15 sec) or by breaking line of sight at the tunnel corner. Save Incapacitating Roar (10 yards, 30 sec) to stop their Lightning Bolts together when Ground Pound (4 sec cast) goes off.
[해제] Shrouded Fang's Poisoned Cheap Shot (5 sec stun and 96982 Nature every sec) is a Poison, so remove it right away with Remove Corruption (8 sec cooldown).
2: [탱버] Never let Ironfur drop under Sandfury Stonefist's Sunder Slam stacks, and add Barkskin (about 34 sec cooldown with talents, 30% reduction for 12 sec) or Lunar Beam (1 min, self-healing for 8 sec) when stacks overlap.
[해제] Engage the two Shrouded Fangs under the stairs before anyone else, and free party members from Poisoned Cheap Shot with Remove Corruption.
4: [해제] Poisonous Viper's Cytotoxin (10 sec Nature DoT) is a Poison, so remove it with Remove Corruption.

5: [탱버] Stack Ironfur to 2-3 for Krolusk Matriarch's Head Butt (3 sec cast, 727368 Physical). If Barbed Krolusk's Serrated Charge bleed is also on you, add Survival Instincts, and press Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc in this pull if it is back from pull 1.

[차단] Interrupt Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Skull Bash. Addle Mind is a 5 sec cast, so leave it to one other player.
7: [해제] Cytotoxin from three Poisonous Vipers keeps coming, so keep Remove Corruption (8 sec cooldown) rolling and clean the players who are likely Venom Bolt targets first.
[차단] Interrupt Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Skull Bash, and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) with Incapacitating Roar instead of a kick.
9: [광역 피해] Agitated Nimbus's Release Charge (145474 Nature to the whole party) is not reduced by Ironfur, so take it with Barkskin. If Dream of Cenarius procs, stay in Bear Form and cast the instant Regrowth on the lowest-health party member.
